# Load slide data catalog

```{r load embeddings}
# prorvigigapath catalog
catalog <- getCatalog("provgigapath")
 
# Get unique cancer project IDs
cancer_types <- unique(catalog$Project.ID)
cat("Number of cancer types:", length(cancer_types), "\n")

# Create an empty list to hold slide catalogs
slide_catalogs <- list()

# Loop over each cancer type
for (proj in cancer_types) {
  # Filter to slide-level and this project
  sub <- catalog |>
    dplyr::filter(level == "slide_level", Project.ID == proj)
  
  # Store only if there are slides
  if (nrow(sub) > 0) {
    slide_catalogs[[proj]] <- sub
    cat(proj, ":", nrow(sub), "slides\n")
  } else {
    cat(proj, ": no slide-level data\n")
  }
}

# Check which cancers are available
names(slide_catalogs)

```


#### Pull Cancer Embedding
```{r}


# Define the helper function
get_aligned_embedding_metadata <- function(mae_emb) {
  if (is.null(rownames(mae_emb[["slide_assay"]]))) {
    rownames(mae_emb[["slide_assay"]]) <- paste0("slide_feat_", seq_len(nrow(mae_emb[["slide_assay"]])))
  }
  slide_sm <- sampleMap(mae_emb)[sampleMap(mae_emb)$assay == "slide_assay", ]
  patients <- unique(slide_sm$primary)
  aligned <- list()
  for (nm in names(experiments(mae_emb))) {
    se <- experiments(mae_emb)[[nm]]
    mat <- assay(se)
    sm <- sampleMap(mae_emb)[sampleMap(mae_emb)$assay == nm, ]
    col_patients <- sm$primary[match(colnames(mat), sm$colname)]
    patient_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = length(patients),
                          dimnames = list(rownames(mat), patients))
    for (pat in patients) {
      cols <- which(col_patients == pat)
      if (length(cols) == 1) patient_mat[, pat] <- mat[, cols]
      else if (length(cols) > 1) patient_mat[, pat] <- rowMeans(mat[, cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    if (!is.numeric(patient_mat)) {
      patient_mat <- matrix(as.numeric(patient_mat), nrow = nrow(patient_mat),
                            dimnames = dimnames(patient_mat))
    }
    keep <- rowSums(!is.na(patient_mat)) > 0
    aligned[[nm]] <- patient_mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  embed_mat <- t(aligned[["slide_assay"]])
  embed_mat <- embed_mat[complete.cases(embed_mat), ]
  coldata <- as.data.frame(colData(mae_emb))
  coldata$patient <- TCGAbarcode(rownames(coldata), participant = TRUE)
  meta <- coldata[!duplicated(coldata$patient), ]
  rownames(meta) <- meta$patient
  common <- intersect(rownames(embed_mat), rownames(meta))
  embed_meta <- embed_mat[common, , drop = FALSE]
  meta_sub <- meta[common, , drop = FALSE]
  return(list(embed = embed_meta, meta = meta_sub))
}

# Get list of cancer project IDs from the catalog
cancer_types <- unique(catalog$Project.ID)
cat("Total cancer types:", length(cancer_types), "\n")

# Storage lists
all_embeddings <- list()
all_metadata  <- list()

for (proj in cancer_types) {
  cat("\n==== Processing", proj, "====\n")
  
  # 1. Slide catalog for this cancer
  slide_cat <- catalog |>
    dplyr::filter(level == "slide_level", Project.ID == proj)
  
  if (nrow(slide_cat) == 0) {
    cat("No slides, skipping.\n")
    next
  }
  
  disease_code <- sub("TCGA-", "", proj)
  
  # 2. Download molecular data (only one assay to minimise size)
  mae <- tryCatch(
    curatedTCGAData(
      diseaseCode = disease_code,
      assays = "RNASeq2GeneNorm",   # widely available
      version = "2.1.1",
      dry.run = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("  Molecular download failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  if (is.null(mae)) next
  
  # 3. Link slide and molecular data
  linked <- tryCatch(
    linkTCGA(mae, slide_cat, redownload = FALSE, parallel = TRUE),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("  linkTCGA failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  if (is.null(linked)) next
  
  # 4. Align embeddings per patient
  aligned <- tryCatch(
    get_aligned_embedding_metadata(linked),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("  Alignment failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  if (is.null(aligned) || nrow(aligned$embed) == 0) {
    cat("  No aligned patients.\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Add cancer type to metadata
  aligned$meta$Cancer <- sub("TCGA-", "", proj)
  
  # Store
  all_embeddings[[proj]] <- aligned$embed
  all_metadata[[proj]]  <- aligned$meta
  
  cat("  Done – patients:", nrow(aligned$embed), "\n")
}

saveRDS(all_embeddings, "all_cancer_embeddings.rds")



names(all_cancer_metadata)

```



### Combine Embedding
```{r}
# ---- 1. Load embeddings if not already in memory ----
if (!exists("all_embeddings")) {
  all_embeddings <- readRDS("all_cancer_embeddings.rds")
}

# ---- 2. Prepare metadata list ----
# Ensure all_metadata exists
if (!exists("all_metadata")) {
  stop("all_metadata not found. Please re-run the loop or load it.")
}

# Process each metadata element
for (proj in names(all_metadata)) {
  meta <- all_metadata[[proj]]
  
  # Add Patient column if not present
  if (!"Patient" %in% colnames(meta)) {
    if ("patient" %in% colnames(meta)) {
      meta$Patient <- meta$patient
    } else {
      meta$Patient <- rownames(meta)
    }
  }
  
  # Ensure Patient is participant-level (e.g., TCGA-XX-XXXX)
  meta$Patient <- TCGAbarcode(meta$Patient, participant = TRUE)
  
  # Set rownames to Patient for alignment
  rownames(meta) <- meta$Patient
  
  # Add Cancer column if not present
  if (!"Cancer" %in% colnames(meta)) {
    meta$Cancer <- sub("TCGA-", "", proj)
  }
  
  all_metadata[[proj]] <- meta
}

# ---- 3. Align embedding features ----
# Check if column names are present
has_colnames <- any(sapply(all_embeddings, function(mat) !is.null(colnames(mat))))

if (has_colnames) {
  # Use intersection of feature names
  common_features <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(all_embeddings, colnames))
  cat("Common features:", length(common_features), "\n")
  all_embeddings <- lapply(all_embeddings, function(mat) {
    mat[, common_features, drop = FALSE]
  })
} else {
  # No column names: assume same order, use minimum column count
  min_cols <- min(sapply(all_embeddings, ncol))
  cat("No column names – using minimum columns:", min_cols, "\n")
  all_embeddings <- lapply(all_embeddings, function(mat) {
    mat[, 1:min_cols, drop = FALSE]
  })
}

# ---- 4. Combine embeddings ----
embeddings_combined <- do.call(rbind, all_embeddings)

# ---- 5. Combine metadata ----
metadata_combined_all <- do.call(rbind.fill, all_metadata)
rownames(metadata_combined_all) <- metadata_combined_all$Patient

# ---- 6. Align patients ----
common_patients <- intersect(rownames(embeddings_combined), rownames(metadata_combined_all))
cat("Common patients:", length(common_patients), "\n")

embeddings_combined <- embeddings_combined[common_patients, , drop = FALSE]
metadata_combined_all <- metadata_combined_all[common_patients, , drop = FALSE]

# ---- 7. Save final combined objects ----
saveRDS(embeddings_combined, "embeddings_combined_all_cancers.rds")
saveRDS(metadata_combined_all, "metadata_combined_all_cancers.rds")

cat("Final embeddings dimensions:", dim(embeddings_combined), "\n")
cat("Final metadata dimensions:", dim(metadata_combined_all), "\n")
cat("Cancer types:", length(unique(metadata_combined_all$Cancer)), "\n")
```

### Add batch Var

```{r}
# 1. Ensure slide_catalogs exists (if not, rebuild from catalog)
if (!exists("slide_catalogs")) {
  slide_catalogs <- split(catalog, catalog$Project.ID) %>%
    lapply(function(df) dplyr::filter(df, level == "slide_level"))
}

# 2. Build a patient-level lookup table: Patient -> TSS.Code
tss_lookup <- bind_rows(lapply(slide_catalogs, function(slide_df) {
  slide_df %>%
    mutate(Patient = TCGAbarcode(tcga_barcode, participant = TRUE)) %>%
    select(Patient, TSS.Code) %>%
    distinct(Patient, .keep_all = TRUE)
}))

# 3. If metadata_combined_all doesn't have a Patient column, create from rownames
if (!"Patient" %in% colnames(metadata_combined_all)) {
  metadata_combined_all$Patient <- rownames(metadata_combined_all)
}

# 4. Attach TSS.Code via left join
metadata_combined_all <- metadata_combined_all %>%
  left_join(tss_lookup, by = "Patient")

# 5. Check for missing TSS.Code
cat("Missing TSS.Code:", sum(is.na(metadata_combined_all$Tissue.source.site)), "\n")

```


# Visualize PCA embed + batch


```{r}


# Ensure metadata is aligned with embeddings (by patient ID)
common_ids <- intersect(rownames(embeddings_combined), rownames(metadata_combined_all))
emb_pca <- embeddings_combined[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]
meta_pca <- metadata_combined_all[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]

# Run PCA (center and scale for stable results)
pca_res <- prcomp(emb_pca, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Create data frame for plotting
combined_pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_res$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_res$x[, 2],
  Cancer = meta_pca$Cancer,
  TSS = meta_pca$TSS.Code
)

# Plot by cancer type
p_cancer <- ggplot(combined_pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Cancer)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95, linetype = 2) +
  labs(title = "PCA – coloured by cancer type",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(summary(pca_res)$importance[2,1]*100,1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(summary(pca_res)$importance[2,2]*100,1), "%)")) +
  theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")

# Plot by TSS.Code (tissue source site)
p_tss <- ggplot(combined_pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = TSS)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "PCA – coloured by TSS.Code (batch)",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(summary(pca_res)$importance[2,1]*100,1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(summary(pca_res)$importance[2,2]*100,1), "%)")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")   # too many TSS codes; hide legend for clarity

p_cancer / p_tss
```

# Corrected Permanova


```{r}
# 1. Align embeddings and metadata (by rownames)
common_ids <- intersect(rownames(embeddings_combined), rownames(metadata_combined_all))
emb_orig <- embeddings_combined[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]
meta     <- metadata_combined_all[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]

# 2. Remove rows with missing Cancer or TSS.Code
keep <- complete.cases(meta$Cancer, meta$TSS.Code)
meta <- meta[keep, , drop = FALSE]
emb_orig <- emb_orig[keep, , drop = FALSE]

# 3. Reorder both by rownames to ensure exact alignment
ord <- order(rownames(emb_orig))
emb_orig <- emb_orig[ord, , drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[ord, , drop = FALSE]

# 4. Convert to factors and drop unused levels
meta$Cancer   <- droplevels(as.factor(meta$Cancer))
meta$TSS.Code <- droplevels(as.factor(meta$TSS.Code))

# 5. Transpose embeddings (features x samples)
embed_t <- t(emb_orig)
batch   <- meta$TSS.Code

# 5. Batch correction
# ComBat (no covariates)
combat_res <- ComBat(dat = embed_t,
                     batch = batch,
                     mod = NULL,
                     par.prior = TRUE,
                     prior.plots = FALSE)
emb_combat <- t(combat_res)
rownames(emb_combat) <- rownames(emb_orig)

# limma removeBatchEffect (with Cancer covariate)
design_cancer <- model.matrix(~ Cancer , data = meta)

limma_res <- removeBatchEffect(x = embed_t,
                               batch = batch,
                               design = design_cancer)
emb_limma <- t(limma_res)
rownames(emb_limma) <- rownames(emb_orig)


```


## Permanova
```{r}



# 6. PERMANOVA (sequential, by = "terms")
library(vegan)

# Original
dist_orig <- dist(emb_orig, method = "euclidean")
res_orig <- adonis2(dist_orig ~ Cancer + TSS.Code,
                    data = meta,
                    permutations = 99,
                    by = "terms")

# ComBat
dist_combat <- dist(emb_combat, method = "euclidean")
res_combat <- adonis2(dist_combat ~ Cancer + TSS.Code,
                      data = meta,
                      permutations = 99,
                      by = "terms")

# limma
dist_limma <- dist(emb_limma, method = "euclidean")
res_limma <- adonis2(dist_limma ~ Cancer + TSS.Code,
                     data = meta,
                     permutations = 99,
                     by = "terms")

# 7. Summary table
corrected_perm_df <- data.frame(
  Method = c("Original", "ComBat", "limma"),
  R2_Cancer = c(res_orig["Cancer", "R2"],
                res_combat["Cancer", "R2"],
                res_limma["Cancer", "R2"]),
  P_Cancer = c(res_orig["Cancer", "Pr(>F)"],
               res_combat["Cancer", "Pr(>F)"],
               res_limma["Cancer", "Pr(>F)"]),
  R2_TSS = c(res_orig["TSS.Code", "R2"],
             res_combat["TSS.Code", "R2"],
             res_limma["TSS.Code", "R2"]),
  P_TSS = c(res_orig["TSS.Code", "Pr(>F)"],
            res_combat["TSS.Code", "Pr(>F)"],
            res_limma["TSS.Code", "Pr(>F)"])
)

print(corrected_perm_df)


```

```{r}
# ============================================
# Professional Table 1 + R² Comparison Table

library(dplyr)
library(gt)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. R² comparison table
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("corrected_perm_df")) {
  if (exists("res_orig") & exists("res_combat") & exists("res_limma")) {
    corrected_perm_df <- data.frame(
      Method = c("Original", "ComBat", "limma"),
      R2_Cancer = c(res_orig["Cancer", "R2"],
                    res_combat["Cancer", "R2"],
                    res_limma["Cancer", "R2"]),
      P_Cancer = c(res_orig["Cancer", "Pr(>F)"],
                   res_combat["Cancer", "Pr(>F)"],
                   res_limma["Cancer", "Pr(>F)"]),
      R2_TSS = c(res_orig["TSS.Code", "R2"],
                 res_combat["TSS.Code", "R2"],
                 res_limma["TSS.Code", "R2"]),
      P_TSS = c(res_orig["TSS.Code", "Pr(>F)"],
                res_combat["TSS.Code", "Pr(>F)"],
                res_limma["TSS.Code", "Pr(>F)"])
    )
  } else {
    stop("Neither corrected_perm_df nor res_* objects found. Run PERMANOVA first.")
  }
}

r2_table_gt <- corrected_perm_df %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Variance explained by cancer type and tissue source site",
    subtitle = "Sequential PERMANOVA before and after batch correction"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = starts_with("R2"), decimals = 4) %>%
  fmt_scientific(columns = starts_with("P"), decimals = 3) %>%
  cols_label(
    Method = "Method",
    R2_Cancer = "R² Cancer",
    P_Cancer = "P Cancer",
    R2_TSS = "R² Tissue Source Site",
    P_TSS = "P Tissue Source Site"
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 12,
    heading.align = "center"
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# Comprehensive Table 1 + Site Summary
# ============================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Patient and slide counts
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
patient_counts <- metadata_combined_all %>%
  dplyr::count(Cancer, name = "Patients") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Patients))

slide_counts <- data.frame(
  Cancer = sub("TCGA-", "", names(slide_catalogs)),
  Slides = sapply(slide_catalogs, nrow),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Birth year summary (median, IQR)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
birth_year_summary <- metadata_combined_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(years_to_birth)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cancer) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    `Birth Year (median, IQR)` = paste0(
      round(median(years_to_birth), 1),
      " (", round(quantile(years_to_birth, 0.25), 1),
      ", ", round(quantile(years_to_birth, 0.75), 1), ")"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Gender summary (% female)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
gender_summary <- metadata_combined_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gender)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cancer) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    `Female (%)` = paste0(
      sum(gender == "female"), " (", round(100 * mean(gender == "female"), 1), "%)"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Vital status summary (% deceased, assuming 1 = deceased)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
vital_summary <- metadata_combined_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(vital_status)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cancer) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    `Deceased (%)` = paste0(
      sum(vital_status == 1), " (", round(100 * mean(vital_status == 1), 1), "%)"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. FFPE summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
ffpe_summary <- metadata_combined_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(patient.samples.sample.is_ffpe)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cancer) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    `FFPE (%)` = paste0(
      sum(patient.samples.sample.is_ffpe == "yes"), " (",
      round(100 * mean(patient.samples.sample.is_ffpe == "yes"), 1), "%)"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Tumor nuclei and necrosis summaries
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
tumor_nuclei_summary <- metadata_combined_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(patient.samples.sample.portions.portion.slides.slide.percent_tumor_nuclei)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cancer) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    `Tumor Nuclei (%)` = paste0(
      round(median(patient.samples.sample.portions.portion.slides.slide.percent_tumor_nuclei), 1),
      " (", round(quantile(patient.samples.sample.portions.portion.slides.slide.percent_tumor_nuclei, 0.25), 1),
      ", ", round(quantile(patient.samples.sample.portions.portion.slides.slide.percent_tumor_nuclei, 0.75), 1), ")"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

necrosis_summary <- metadata_combined_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(patient.samples.sample.portions.portion.slides.slide.percent_necrosis)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cancer) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    `Necrosis (%)` = paste0(
      round(median(patient.samples.sample.portions.portion.slides.slide.percent_necrosis), 1),
      " (", round(quantile(patient.samples.sample.portions.portion.slides.slide.percent_necrosis, 0.25), 1),
      ", ", round(quantile(patient.samples.sample.portions.portion.slides.slide.percent_necrosis, 0.75), 1), ")"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Predominant histology
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
histology_summary <- metadata_combined_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(histological_type)) %>%
  dplyr::count(Cancer, histological_type) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cancer) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(Cancer, `Predominant Histology` = histological_type)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Site summary (unique sites, top site, second site)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 1: Count patients per Cancer x TSS.Code
site_counts <- metadata_combined_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TSS.Code)) %>%
  dplyr::count(Cancer, TSS.Code)

# Step 2: Total patients and number of unique sites per cancer
cancer_summary <- site_counts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cancer) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_patients = sum(n),
    unique_sites = dplyr::n_distinct(TSS.Code)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Step 3: Top site
top1 <- site_counts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cancer) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::rename(top_site = TSS.Code, top_n = n) %>%
  dplyr::select(Cancer, top_site, top_n) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Step 4: Second top site
top2 <- site_counts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cancer) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(n, n = 2, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::row_number() == 2) %>%
  dplyr::rename(second_site = TSS.Code, second_n = n) %>%
  dplyr::select(Cancer, second_site, second_n) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Step 5: Combine and compute percentages, format as "site (xx.x%)"
site_summary <- cancer_summary %>%
  dplyr::left_join(top1, by = "Cancer") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(top2, by = "Cancer") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    top_site_pct = 100 * top_n / total_patients,
    second_site_pct = 100 * second_n / total_patients,
    `Top Site (%)` = paste0(top_site, " (", round(top_site_pct, 1), "%)"),
    `Second Site (%)` = ifelse(!is.na(second_site), 
                               paste0(second_site, " (", round(second_site_pct, 1), "%)"), 
                               "")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Cancer, unique_sites, `Top Site (%)`, `Second Site (%)`)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Combine everything
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
table1_data <- patient_counts %>%
  dplyr::left_join(slide_counts, by = "Cancer") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(birth_year_summary, by = "Cancer") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gender_summary, by = "Cancer") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(vital_summary, by = "Cancer") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ffpe_summary, by = "Cancer") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(tumor_nuclei_summary, by = "Cancer") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(necrosis_summary, by = "Cancer") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(histology_summary, by = "Cancer") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(site_summary, by = "Cancer")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Build Table with gt
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
table1_gt <- table1_data %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Table 1. Cohort summary by cancer type",
    subtitle = "TCGA image embeddings with linked RNASeq data"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Cancer = "Cancer Type",
    Patients = "Patients",
    Slides = "Slides",
    `Birth Year (median, IQR)` = "Birth Year (median, IQR)",
    `Female (%)` = "Female, n (%)",
    `Deceased (%)` = "Deceased, n (%)",
    `FFPE (%)` = "FFPE, n (%)",
    `Tumor Nuclei (%)` = "Tumor Nuclei % (median, IQR)",
    `Necrosis (%)` = "Necrosis % (median, IQR)",
    `Predominant Histology` = "Predominant Histology",
    unique_sites = "Unique Sites",
    `Top Site (%)` = "Top Site (%)",
    `Second Site (%)` = "Second Site (%)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(Patients, Slides), decimals = 0) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 12,
    heading.align = "center"
  )
```

```{r}

# Step 1: Count patients per Cancer x TSS.Code
site_counts <- metadata_combined_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TSS.Code)) %>%
  dplyr::count(Cancer, TSS.Code)

# Step 2: Total patients and number of unique sites per cancer
cancer_summary <- site_counts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cancer) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_patients = sum(n),
    unique_sites = dplyr::n_distinct(TSS.Code)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Step 3: Top site for each cancer
top1 <- site_counts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cancer) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::rename(top_site = TSS.Code, top_n = n) %>%
  dplyr::select(Cancer, top_site, top_n) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Step 4: Second top site (if exists)
top2 <- site_counts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Cancer) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(n, n = 2, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::row_number() == 2) %>%
  dplyr::rename(second_site = TSS.Code, second_n = n) %>%
  dplyr::select(Cancer, second_site, second_n) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Step 5: Combine everything
site_summary <- cancer_summary %>%
  dplyr::left_join(top1, by = "Cancer") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(top2, by = "Cancer") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    top_site_pct = 100 * top_n / total_patients,
    second_site_pct = 100 * second_n / total_patients
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Cancer, total_patients, unique_sites,
    top_site, top_site_pct,
    second_site, second_site_pct
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(top_site_pct))

# View result
print(site_summary, n = Inf)
```
